text:
Noah: follow-up from yesterday's canary: we still see customers billed for both the primary and fallback responses. can we prevent double-charge without killing observability?
Priya: short answer: yes, but we need a decision id we can attach to both attempts so billing dedup can run later. router today doesn't expose a stable request_id across retries.
Chloe: UX ask: show a 'billing state' on rollout details: Pending / Deduped / Billed. if a dedupe job runs later, update the UI and send a one-line invoice note.
Noah: idea: emit request_id + attempt_index and decision_tag (primary|fallback) in telemetry. billing pipeline dedupes based on request_id and a canonical scoring function.
Priya: caution: that means router must not synthesize new request_ids for internal retries; it must propagate upstream id where possible. edge-cases: client retries with different ids.
Liam: we can attach a 'canonical_id' header at the gateway and prefer that for billing. if absent, fallback to generated id but mark as 'non-canonical' so dedupe is conservative.
Chloe: For console: we should surface a timeline event when dedupe kicks in: "Dedup job ran: -8.2k tokens adjusted" and link to audit event.
FinanceBot: note: finance requests that any token-credit adjustments include a short reason code and ledger id. otherwise reconciliation is hard.
Priya: audit schema proposal: rollout_token_adjustment with fields (rollout_id, canonical_request_id, tokens_before, tokens_after, ledger_id, actor=system, reason_code=dedupe, ts). exclude model outputs.
Noah: another angle: what about charge semantics for transient fallbacks (e.g., fallback that returns a short canned response then primary completes longer)? we should define which responder is authoritative for billing.
Liam: proposal: authoritative_responder = earliest_successful_non-error. if primary later completes successfully but after fallback responded, we consider the response served by whichever returned first, but only bill tokens once using canonical_id.
Chloe: ops want a knob: 'prefer-primary-billing' for certain customers so we bill primary even if fallback returned first (useful for customers paying for premium). adds complexity.
Priya: if we add that knob, we must add strict guardrails: only enabled per-org, must be explicit in contract, and write audit event when toggled.
Noah: telemetry: we'd also like a small histogram of per-route dedupe latencies (time between first responder and dedupe run) to understand lag. don't sample full traces for every dedupe — a metric will do.
Liam: implementation sketch: gateway emits metric dedupe_candidate{route, org} when fallback occurs. dedupe worker consumes billing events and emits adjustment events. UI subscribes to adjustment stream.
Chloe: UI mock: on rollout timeline show small orange badge for "dedupe pending" and green for "dedupe applied". Clicking expands to show ledger id and who approved the adjustment (system or manual).
Priya: manual adjustments: support team must be able to apply manual corrections with justification; those must create an audit event with actor, reason, amount, ledger_id. also require 2FA if amount > threshold.
Noah: security note: never include request payloads or model output in audit/adjustment events. only ids, reason codes, token deltas.
FinanceBot: Finance: please include a daily digest of adjustments to the billing export so downstream systems can reconcile.
DevOps-bot: task created: PLAT-5192 "dedupe pipeline + canonical_id header + UI adjustments" assigned to priya, liam. staging target next week.
Noah: next steps: Priya to spec canonical_id header + dedupe algorithm; Liam to add billing API hooks; Chloe to update mockups and include ledger display; Finance will provide example CSV columns. sync Wed 11am.
Liam: I'll add a feature flag for canonical_id propagation and a migration plan for older clients.
Chloe: will post Figma and short gif showing the badge state transitions.
Priya: thanks — I'll keep audit schema minimal and post in this thread.
Noah: great work team. any objections to the plan?
Priya: none from infra.
Liam: all good.
Chloe: thumbs up :white_check_mark:
